faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Bhopal JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at AIIMS Bhopal is 27th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: The required qualification is a Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR a graduate/Post Graduate Degree in a Professional Course selected through National Eligibility Tests like CSIR-UGC NET or GATE.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow post is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC candidates as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, according to the provided data, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the JRF post?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 37000/- per month plus 18% HRA, totaling Rs. 43660/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the JRF post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at AIIMS Bhopal.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for the AIIMS Bhopal JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official website.

faq.question: Q9. Where is AIIMS Bhopal located?
faq.answer: AIIMS Bhopal is located in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, with the pincode 462020.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is AIIMS/BPL/TM/2026/2725.
